integrity: The mathematical argument is analytic, with independent symbolic and covariance-operator checks. No assertion of independent scholarly audit or novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent stationary OU factors, positive decay rates and variances, nonzero product coupling, and independent additive Brownian noise. Exact population moments; rates identified only up to exchange. The noise-separated fourth cumulant is not itself a finite-sample estimator. No conclusion for correlated or non-Gaussian factors or nonstationary initialization.
title: Fourth-order identifiability and a sharp kurtosis floor in active dimers
